claim_scope: Label-free integrity and physical-input audit for one prospective 3D-RISM solvent asset. Passing establishes only that a supplied molecular site model, 1D-RISM input, and XVV susceptibility agree with one another. It does not run a solvation calculation, read an experimental solvation value, fit a parameter, enable a Route 1 runtime solvent, or establish any accuracy or ranking claim.

literature.amber_rism_workflow: AmberTools Users' Manual, RISM chapter: 1D-RISM constructs the bulk-solvent XVV consumed by rism3d.snglpnt; the supplied molecular model and thermodynamic state define that susceptibility.
literature.theory: Sergiievskyi, Jeanmairet, Levesque, and Borgis, Solvation free-energy pressure corrections in the Three Dimensional Reference Interaction Site Model, arXiv:1511.04475.
literature.local_provider_boundary: A validated asset may be wired only into a separate benchmark-only 3D-RISM candidate after numerical, standard-state, force, multi-solvent, and independent external validation gates pass.
